MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p.nationality AS nationality, CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE) AS birth_date
WITH nationality, DATE_DIFF('year', birth_date, DATE('2026-10-14')) - CASE WHEN DATE_PART('month', birth_date) > 10 OR (DATE_PART('month', birth_date) = 10 AND DATE_PART('day', birth_date) > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2
